arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Goldsmith argued California defunded employer speech. He claimed this conflicts with federal policy.
Mr. Gottesman argued California financed one side of debates. He said the law created an anomaly.
Mr. Hungar argued state laws frustrate national policy. He cited the Linn decision as precedent.
